description: Required/optional field schema for Nigerian catering SMEs. Used by parse_client_brief and generate_clarifying_questions.

required_fields.label: Event Type
clarifying_question_templates: What kind of event are we catering for?

required_fields.label: Guest Count
clarifying_question_templates: Roughly how many guests will be eating?

required_fields.label: Venue / Location
clarifying_question_templates: Where will the event be held?

required_fields.label: Meal Type
clarifying_question_templates: Would you prefer a buffet, plated service, or cocktail-style?

optional_fields.label: Dietary Requirements
clarifying_question_templates: Any dietary restrictions or special meal needs?

optional_fields.label: Drinks Included
clarifying_question_templates: Should we include drinks in the package?

field_completeness_rules.notes: All required fields must be present before a quote can be computed.

ambiguity_handling.note: Treat vague guest count as missing. Ask for an estimate.
